§7.6 requires every webhook to be idempotent with failed deliveries going to a dead letter queue with manual replay available from Admin — but no endpoint to list or replay that queue was in §7.4. Give me GET /v1/admin/webhooks/dead-letter and POST /v1/admin/webhooks/dead-letter/{id}/replay (or similar) and this table becomes real, with the Replay button wired up.
